title: Read the supplied string-sort callback
description: You can follow how the given example sorts C integer indices and then retrieves Python strings.

steps.description: The platform branch loads a C library on the supported systems. COMP declares a callback receiving two pointers and returning an integer.
The words stay in a Python list. A separate C integer array stores their indices.
The supplied comparator reads two indices through pointers and retrieves the corresponding words. Its existing branches compare length and then text.

steps.question: Does qsort rearrange words directly in this snippet?
steps.answer: No. It rearranges c_indices, which the later comprehension uses to retrieve words.

steps.description: comp_fn keeps the callback wrapper available during qsort. The recorded word list starts with fig and ends with banana and cherry.
